evidence.primary: FoldaRap 4.0 maker repository BOM and version-specific RepRap FoldaRap entry
evidence.scope_note: This profile graph was newly normalized from the source-scoped dossier because the graph file cited by the inherited snapshot was missing. The maker BOM is a design inventory, not proof of the specific unit’s installed controller, power configuration, connector faces, switch pole selection, conductor order, motor coils, or electrical compatibility. A/B labels on source-counted two-pin groups are display indexes only. Firmware sources are alternate configuration examples; do not combine them into a fitted board pinout. The BOM lists a KPJX-PM-4S jack and a shielded -S alternative; Kycon contact positions are shown as reference only with all FoldaRap functions and routes OPEN. No source-verified FoldaRap 4.0 DB25 peripheral or SmoothieBox route is established here.
